svg.title: Autonomous behavior before and after a rule switch

cc:Work.dc:title: Autonomous behavior before and after a rule switch
cc:Work.dc:description: Each point scores the first item in its full 50-turn window: +1 food, −1 poison, 0 no item or death before contact. Whiskers: ±1 family SE. Four originally assigned creatures and both initial rules are averaged within each family. Solid curves reverse before turn-150 consumption. Dashed curves keep the rule fixed. Every assigned creature counts. Evolutionary-recovery gate: 0/3 lineages; all three required. This compares two saved evolutionary endpoints. A0: descendant reversal Q before switch +0.414 ± 0.0428, early −0.412 ± 0.0431, late −0.0684 ± 0.0342; founder late +0.0273 ± 0.0306. A1: descendant reversal Q before switch +0.354 ± 0.0442, early −0.436 ± 0.0391, late −0.0586 ± 0.0353; founder late +0.00586 ± 0.0291. A2: descendant reversal Q before switch +0.395 ± 0.0328, early −0.506 ± 0.0376, late −0.0723 ± 0.0312; founder late +0.0391 ± 0.0265.
